description: This file contains utility functions for analyzing textual documents, including heuristics for extracting entities, generating summaries, and classifying documents into domains like Web Application, Infrastructure, or Data Analytics. It also provides a public function 'analyzeDocuments' that processes a list of document objects to produce insights such as summaries, key points, entities, and domain classification.

methods.name: slugify(text)
methods.description: Converts text into a URL-friendly slug by lowercasing, replacing non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens, and trimming hyphens from ends.

methods.name: firstNonEmptyLines(text, maxLines)
methods.description: Extracts the first few non-empty lines from a given text up to a maximum number.

methods.name: keywordMatchScore(haystack, keywords)
methods.description: Calculates a score based on how many keywords are present within a haystack string.

methods.name: guessSummaryFromName(filename)
methods.description: Generates a high-level summary based on the filename, identifying potential document purposes like architecture or project notes.

methods.name: extractEntities(text)
methods.description: Naively detects entities or keywords in text, including common terms and capitalized words.
